$schema_note: Merchant, bank and provider names. CLEAN ROOM: every name here is either a publicly known retail or service brand, or an invented one — invented sole-trader names use the ФОП/JDG/EK/AUTONOMO convention with a made-up surname and initials and denote no real person. Never a customer, employer or colleague list. The brand-shaped blocks (banks, payment_providers, fiscal_software, fiscal_hardware, marketplaces) determine the LAYOUT of an archetype and must stay recognizable; the vendors and aggregators blocks are only the counterparty string printed on a document, where naming-pattern coverage matters more than fame. `fiscal_software` and `fiscal_hardware` are a third case again — neither the counterparty nor a layout owner, but the MAKER OF THE REGISTER printed at the foot of a fiscal receipt, which is why each carries its own basis-for-publicness note.

banks.$note: The issuer of a payment confirmation. `printed_name` is what appears in the document header and is the only field the generator prints; `display_name` names the mark in Latin for a reader of this file. ONE TEMPLATE FOR ALL FOUR UA ISSUERS, and the repetition is the point: three real banks were observed and their layouts differ, but only the FIELD SET is evidenced well enough to model, so `template` names one archetype for every issuer and the layout diversity between banks is a declared gap in config/labelling-schema.yaml rather than four templates guessed at. The key is kept — an issuer whose layout IS eventually evidenced gets its own value here without a change of shape. `bank_code` is the МФО printed beside this name wherever a document names this bank — an INVENTED six-digit code, shaped like a real one (see config/fiscal-rules.yaml `identifiers.bank_code`) but equal to none, and FIXED here rather than drawn: `config.bank_codes` looks a name up in this table instead of drawing a code afresh, which is what keeps one name from ever carrying two codes.

acquirers.$note: Printed in the 'Екв.' field of the card-acquiring block on a Ukrainian fiscal receipt. Public bank names, in the legal form a receipt spells them out in. Kept apart from `banks` above: an acquirer is a string on someone else's receipt and determines no layout, whereas a `banks` entry owns a template.

fiscal_software.$note: ПРРО SOFTWARE PROVIDERS, printed at the foot of a Ukrainian fiscal receipt as the «виробник» of 📄 line 35 of the form. READ BY THE GENERATOR as of the commit that added the two further fiscal-receipt archetypes; it used to be declared and read by nothing, which made it dead data sitting beside live data. `content_builder` draws one per document through `receipt.registrars.prro.maker_pool` in config/fiscal-rules.yaml, which names this block rather than copying it. Every mark here is PUBLICLY MARKETED ПРРО software with a live site of its own, which is what makes it usable at all: the rule at the head of config/generation.yaml admits no invented-mark class, because publicness is verifiable and inventedness is not. Each is used only for the trade it is publicly in — ПРРО software — exactly as the vendor and acquirer names are. Basis for each, so the claim is checkable rather than asserted: checkbox.ua, kasa.vchasno.com.ua, cashalot.ua, joinposter.com/ua/programniy-rro, e-check.com.ua, webchek.com.ua. NO `title_suffix` ON ANY ENTRY, and that is a finding rather than an omission — see `registrars` in config/fiscal-rules.yaml.

fiscal_hardware.$note: HARDWARE РРО MANUFACTURERS, the other population 📄 line 35 draws from: a classic register has a physical maker, where a ПРРО has only a software provider. Drawn through `receipt.registrars.rro.maker_pool` in config/fiscal-rules.yaml. WHAT MAKES THESE PUBLIC IS A PUBLISHED GOVERNMENT REGISTER, which is a stronger basis than a marketing site: the Державний реєстр реєстраторів розрахункових операцій — the State Register of cash registers kept by the ДПС — lists every device model approved for use in Ukraine together with its manufacturer, and is published as open data (data.gov.ua dataset 1b1c829b-0699-4be3-a493-9d13382a68cc, mirroring tax.gov.ua/dovidniki--reestri--perelik/reestri/320822.html). Names below are manufacturers appearing in that register; `Екселліо` (Exellio) is the Ukrainian-market brand of the same Bulgarian maker as `Datecs`, and both appear. ШТРІХ-М and similar marks are deliberately ABSENT: they were looked for in the register and not found, so nothing establishes them as approved for use here.

vendor_profiles.$note: Vendor -> item-kind affinity. A pharmacy does not sell a personalised nutrition plan, and until this block existed nothing stopped it from printing one. Each profile lists every item kind an outlet of that sort can put on a line, across all three policy buckets; the item kinds are the vocabulary of config/policy.yaml and a profile naming one that no category declares is a typo the test suite catches. A vendor carries a profile slug rather than its own list because outlets of the same sort sell the same things — the affinity is a property of the trade, not of the shop.
vendor_profiles.$note_coverage: A profile that intersects a category's covered_items can issue a receipt for that category at all; one that also intersects its excluded_items can carry a MIXED basket. The assembler picks a vendor that can carry the plan rather than letting the builder fail on a vendor that never could.
vendor_profiles.$note_reachability: Two invariants the test suite enforces, both about content that would otherwise vanish or leak without saying so. FIRST: every item kind policy.yaml declares must be sold by some profile, or it is silently absent from every dataset this generator produces. SECOND: every COVERED kind must be sold by at least one profile that also sells something the same category excludes — otherwise a line printing that kind is guaranteed never to appear on a partially-covered document, and the line item alone foretells the label. Some profiles are still covered-only on their own (`private_tutor`, `online_learning_platform`); that is a residual leak on the counterparty, recorded under `known_limitations` in config/labelling-schema.yaml.

vendors.$note: Category keys must match the category ids in config/policy.yaml. `name` is the bare name; the legal form is prefixed at render time — a ТОВ prints ТОВ «Name», a ФОП prints ФОП Surname I. B. without quotes, because a sole trader's name is a person's name and not a firm's. Naming patterns are covered on purpose: legal entity vs sole trader, Cyrillic vs Latin vs mixed, chain vs single outlet.
vendors.$note_names: AN ENTRY WITH NO `name` TRADES UNDER A PERSON'S NAME, AND THAT NAME IS DRAWN, NEVER STORED. `content_builder.resolve_vendor` fills it with a seeded Faker draw in the jurisdiction's locale, once per vendor instance, when the vendor is chosen for a claim — every document of that claim then names the same seller. A stored list of invented personal names would be a standing liability instead: each entry is an unverified claim that no real person trades under it, and it has to be re-checked as the world changes. A seeded draw makes no claim at all, so there is nothing to verify and nothing to re-check. Entries that DO state a name are firms trading under a mark; absence is the signal rather than the legal form, because a German EK may trade under either. Several entries in one category are identical once the name is gone — that is not duplication, it is how many independent sole traders of that profile the draw may pick from, and it keeps their share against the named firms beside them.
vendors.$note_vat_payer: `vat_payer` SAYS WHETHER THIS SELLER IS REGISTERED FOR ПДВ, and it is a property of the vendor — not of its legal form and not of the template. It decides two printed requisites at once: whether the seller block prints a VAT-payer number under «ПН» IN ADDITION to the «ІД» identification code every seller prints (see `identifiers` in config/fiscal-rules.yaml — the two lines are not alternatives, and the lengths follow the type of person), and whether the receipt has a VAT block at all. THE VALUES BELOW ARE A SIMPLIFICATION AND THE AUTHOR'S ASSUMPTION, NOT A STATISTIC: they follow general knowledge of the Ukrainian simplified system — a sole trader on it is usually not registered, a company usually is — and no published share of registered sellers was consulted. Nothing tunes an overall share: the mix of a rendered dataset is whatever the entries of the drawn category happen to be.
vendors.$note_vat_payer_departures: THE FLAG IS PER ENTRY BECAUSE THAT GENERALISATION HAS EXCEPTIONS, AND ONE IS REPRESENTED: a ФОП on the general system, registered, printing a «ПН» line — carrying its own ten-digit РНОКПП, the same number its «ІД» line shows, which is what a registered sole trader does rather than the twelve-digit number a company prints. Its name is DRAWN rather than stored, so the receipt it produces designates nobody and asserts nothing about anyone's tax affairs. That single entry is what makes the status a property of the vendor rather than a rule over `legal_form` — remove it and the two become indistinguishable in the data. THE OPPOSITE DEPARTURE WAS WRITTEN AND THEN REMOVED, and the reason belongs here because the argument that justified it is one this repository has already rejected once. An unregistered COMPANY was configured on a stored name, defended on the ground that the name was invented rather than public. That defends how the value was produced; the objection is about what the rendered image SAYS, and an «ІД» line on a named ТОВ states that this firm is not VAT-registered — in Ukraine an assertion about its turnover and tax regime. Whether a real firm bears that name is unchecked, and a defence resting on inventedness is exactly the reasoning that once put a rare real surname on a published receipt (see `tasks/lessons.md`, 2026-07-29). A SECOND ARGUMENT FOR REMOVING IT HAS SINCE BEEN REFUTED AND IS WITHDRAWN HERE RATHER THAN LEFT STANDING: it said ⛔ no open sample showed a company printing «ІД» at all. One does — a registered company prints «ІД» beside its «ПН». What remains unobserved is narrower: a company that prints «ІД» and NO «ПН», i.e. an unregistered one. The removal stands on the naming argument above, which the correction does not touch. Removing it costs nothing that the surviving departure does not already provide. If a company non-payer is ever wanted, it needs a name that cannot designate a real firm, and a justification that argues from the image rather than from the provenance of the string. The code path is unaffected and remains exercised in tests: a non-payer company printing «ІД» + an ЄДРПОУ is what the Положення prescribes, so the builder must handle it even while no vendor entry produces one.
vendors.$note_vat_payer_scope: ONLY THE UA LISTS CARRY THE FLAG: the requisites it drives are Ukrainian, and the PL / DE / ES lists are seeded rather than filled, so a key there would be shape nobody had filled — what a Polish or German seller's registration prints is that jurisdiction's own question. `content_builder.vendor_is_vat_payer` refuses an entry that omits the flag rather than defaulting it, so a non-UA archetype cannot start rendering before that question is answered.
vendors.$note_ua_provenance: Public chains named here: Аптека АНЦ, Подорожник, Бажаємо здоров'я, Аптека D.S., Аптека 911, Green Forest, Speak Up, Prometheus, Hillel IT School, Beetroot Academy, Книгарня Є, IT Arena, Rozetka, Prom.ua, Sport Life, 5 елемент, FitCurves, Treatfield, ARX, УНІКА, ІНГО, ТАС, Універсальна, Княжа. A public name is used only for a trade the company is publicly in — the same rule the brand vocabulary in config/generation.yaml follows. No ФОП is named here at all any more; those names are drawn, see `$note_names`. The remaining named entries are invented legal-entity names, which are a class of their own and carry no verification claim in this file — settling how they are assured is recorded as its own step.

vitamins_nutrition.$note: The second departure: a sole trader on the GENERAL system, who is registered and prints «ПН» like a company. The name is drawn, so no real trader is described. This entry is why the status cannot be a rule over `legal_form`.

vendors.$note_non_ua: PL / DE / ES are SEEDED, not filled. No non-UA archetype is registered and the price ranges in config/generation.yaml are UAH-only, so nothing renders from these lists yet; they carry enough entries to keep the structure honest and to be extended when the first non-UA template lands. Public brands below: PZU, Warta, Allianz, Speak Up, Empik, Devoxx Poland, Benefit Systems, Zdrofit, CityFit, Apteka Gemini, DOZ Apteka, AXA, Debeka, Goethe-Institut, Thalia, McFit, FitX, DocMorris, Sanitas, Adeslas, Mapfre, Casa del Libro, Codemotion, Basic-Fit, Metropolitan. The JDG, EK and AUTONOMO entries that stated a personal name no longer do: those names are drawn like the Ukrainian ones. Everything else still named is an invented legal-entity name.

aggregators.$note: Payees that break the link between payment and merchant — drives the 'paid via aggregator' imperfection (docs/architecture.md#imperfection-catalogue). Public Ukrainian payment intermediaries.
